inputs.text: high quality video, sharp focus, clean render, detailed textures, cinematic lighting, professional post-production, 4k detail

_meta.title: Positive Prompt (describe the NEW content you want)

inputs.text: blurry, low quality, distorted, glitch, artifacts, flickering, jerky motion, compression artifacts, watermark, noisy, grainy, washed out, banding

_meta.title: Load Source (frame_load_cap = exact source length, per clip)
Resize to Pass-1 Res (aspect-matched per clip)
Pass 1 Sigmas (t2v from noise: 1.0 = full restyle; lower = keep more source look)
Retake @pass-1 res (no source guide, seam-pinned) - the only sampling pass
VAE Decode @ Pass-1 Res (native, no latent upscale)
Trim to Source Length N (drops wrap frames)

_metadata.assumes: the SOURCE already loops (its frame N-1 flows into frame 0)
_metadata.pipeline: source N + wrap 0..p-1 -> LTX t2v-from-noise with loop pinned to a RESTYLED anchor frame (all 3 pins = same anchor) -> native decode -> trim to N. Anchor = frame 0 of a previous sigma-1.0 render with the same prompt (chicken-and-egg solved by bootstrapping from D2-style run).
_metadata.loop_mechanism: All three pins are the SAME restyled anchor image (indices 0, a, b). First and last output frames match the anchor, so the wrap closes on the restyled look. With a sigma-1.0 start the source drives nothing except length; motion is invented from noise + prompt (temporal loop closure is pinned, not copied).
_metadata.frames: driver per clip: node 7 cap=N, 40 len=p, 43/44 = seam pins a/b, sampler 15 indices, 42 len=N; nodes 8/30 = aspect-matched pass-1 WxH (mult of 32, ~960x544 area)

creativity_knobs.node 11 sigmas: 1.0 (default now): prompt-driven invention, anchor provides look+loop | 0.99375: slightly more coherent motion | below ~0.99: source palette leaks back in (low-frequency SNR, measured 2026-09-23)
creativity_knobs.node 15 cond_image_strength: loop-pin strength: 1.0 = seam frames forced to the source's look; lower lets the restyle reach the seam (loop closes by similarity)
creativity_knobs.node 5 prompt: what the DiT invents toward: describe the new look/content (--prompt per batch)
creativity_knobs.source guide: removed: LTXVLoopingSampler attends to optional_guiding_latents at full attention strength regardless of guiding_strength, which copied the source
creativity_knobs.anchor: the pinned anchor frame defines the look AND the loop: restyle it (image edit / different prompt render) and the whole clip follows

_metadata.oom_fallbacks: n/a at 960x544 single tile (~28GB VRAM observed)
_metadata.validate_after: loop-checker + visual: anchor_s100 measured seam 1.13% vs source 3.42%
_metadata.removed_pass2: 2026-09-23: the IC-LoRA pixel-upscaler refine at 1920x1088 rendered the dilated reference's sparse grid literally (brown background + grid of small squares) and cost ~7 min/clip. Pass 2 is gone; git history has it.
_metadata.timing: L40S 288f: ~4.8-5.1 min/clip (8-9 steps), no guide tokens
_metadata.removed_latent_upscaler: 2026-09-23: decoding the LTX 2x latent upscaler output without a re-sample pass smears motion into a crosshatch texture; it must be followed by a refine pass or not used.
_metadata.creativity: Creativity = where pass 1 starts on the distilled schedule '1.0, 0.99375, 0.9875, 0.98125, 0.975, 0.909375, 0.725, 0.421875, 0.0'. Composition, colour and lighting are decided in the 1.0-0.975 steps; starting at 0.909 skips them and only redraws detail on the source (2026-09-23 diagnostics: 0.909 = 7-9% change and prompt ignored, 1.0 = 25% change and prompt fully applied).
